question: How should a GA chatbot QA timeline distinguish measured quality, backend-unavailable runs, and carried-forward historical values?
production_path: investigation: observe hypothesize test conclude reflect
hypothesis: A separate measured-quality lane and availability lane, with dated historical references, preserves the distinctions recorded by GA snapshots and avoids presenting missing quality as zero or as a new measurement.
evidence: GA commit dc2e74cbd992a298f67efb928b5b3754615e1924: state/quality/chatbot-qa/2026-06-08.json reports pass_pct null, degraded true, backend_unavailable, and a carried-forward 94.0 from May 16.

The same GA commit: state/quality/chatbot-qa/2026-06-15.json, 2026-06-19.json, and 2026-07-19.json report non-null pass rates of 75.00, 7.69, and 98.08; each lists 52 prompts but does not prove identical evaluator and corpus revisions.
The same GA commit: docs/quality/README.md distinguishes stale feeds, degraded counts, observation dates, and measured metric values.
W3C WCAG 2.2 Understanding 1.4.1 requires a visual indicator besides color when color conveys information: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/use-of-color
W3C WCAG 2.2 Understanding 1.1.1 describes text alternatives and data tables for charts: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/non-text-content
